capa.subtitle: Dota is one of the best games in the world. What's broken is Valve's competitive environment — even the legends are leaving. Here, the culture has rules.
capa.pillarAnonimatoLine: Public name, reputation attached. No mask, no smurf, no running from the consequences.
capa.pillarMmrLine: Every cycle restarts from zero. #1 becomes reachable again — even for whoever just arrived.
capa.pillarRegiaoLine: A single race, no borders. The best is the best in the world — not “the best in your region”.
capa.doctrineBody: here every player masters the fundamentals of the Fórmula do Dota de Corrida — the same doctrine, the same expectations, everyone in the same game.

lobbies.emptyBody: Sit back and you just watch. Create yours and set the pace.
lobbies.slotTooltipPos1: Hard Carry — Core with top farm priority. Fórmula goal: 5,000 gold by 10 min, 10,000 by 20 (500 GPM).
lobbies.slotTooltipPos2: Mid — the Core that sets the game's pace: solo XP, up to 1 level per minute — the level race. Core goal: 500 GPM.
lobbies.slotTooltipPos3: Offlane — the Core of pressure and space: taking the vulnerable lane's first tower opens farm and hands you the high ground. Whoever has the vision fires first.
lobbies.slotTooltipPos4: Support 4 — rotations serving map objectives, never a hero simulator. Support goal: 2,500 gold by 10 min (250 GPM).
lobbies.slotTooltipPos5: Support 5 — sacrifice for the team. KDA doesn't define performance: a 2/3/15 support with 5,000 gold by 20 min played their role right.
lobbies.confirmLeaveLeader: You're the leader. When you leave, captaincy passes to the next-oldest player. If you're alone, the lobby is discarded. Confirm?
lobbies.confirmEndLobby: End the lobby? As leader, leaving discards the lobby and removes all players. This can't be undone.
lobbies.onlyLeaderStarts: Only the leader can start the match
lobbies.lobbyCreatedBody: Share the password with the other players. Once the Steam bot is live, it creates the Dota lobby and invites everyone automatically.

account.bannedTitle: Your account has been banned from FORMULADOTA.
account.bannedExplain1: A ban is the final step of the progressive moderation system. Your account is frozen — you can't purchase, play, or schedule sessions.
account.bannedExplain2: Any remaining balance will be refunded on a case-by-case basis, except in cases of fraud or bigotry. We'll get in touch to handle it individually.
account.bannedAppealPrefix: To appeal this ban, write to us via
account.suspendedExplain: While suspended, you can't buy packages, schedule matches, or open sessions. Once the period ends, your account automatically returns to normal status.
account.suspendedAppealPrefix: If you believe this was a mistake,

account.errorBody: We hit an unexpected error while processing your request. You can try again, or head back home while we investigate.

doutrina.title: Indoctrination Ritual
doutrina.introBody: It's not a test — it's an initiation, split into 4 Pillars. You advance one short lesson at a time; every answer teaches you. Getting it wrong doesn't fail you; it sends the question back until you understand. At the end, you reach level 6 — Apprentice.
doutrina.progressSaved: Your progress is saved — you can leave and come back anytime.
doutrina.questionWillReturn: · this question returns until you master it.
doutrina.doctrinatedBody: You've proven you know the Fórmula culture. The open lobby is unlocked. From here on, what takes you higher isn't the quiz — it's your conduct in the match.
